q3_cap_external_lookup.search_method: file-name/registry/contract metadata first, restricted to q3,mlp_cap36,/cap/ names; no scientific reruns
q3_cap_external_lookup.limitation: Limited local inventory inspection is not proof that no capped external experiment exists elsewhere.

limitations: All results here predict original uncapped raw quantity. Cap-model metrics must not be subtracted from these numbers or interpreted as an improvement over the same target problem.

External baselines use shared quantity/time output heads and common log1p input under the frozen comparison contracts; these are matched-head encoder adaptations, not each original paper native full-model head.
Per-split/per-metric minima are posthoc descriptive frontiers and may name different models. They must not be combined into one model.
Primary external model may be selected by Validation RMSE, then its SAME frozen model/checkpoint lineage used on Test; no Test-based checkpoint reselection occurred.

Every Test model/seed has directly checked unique target count and shared target/truth/input SHA. Validation values are frozen selected full-population endpoint aggregates with counts and source/state/epoch/input-contract binding; no new validation per-target unique count can be proven from these aggregate files.

The published comparison originally documented small endpoint/replay numerical differences within abs/rel1e-5. This report preserves its original per-seed CSV values and checks the frozen RAF registry at that tolerance.
Test receipts show old native runtime cohort(s) listed above; Cap uses its separate runtime/assignment. Runtime equivalence must not be assumed.
Results reuse previously accessed Test data and are exploratory comparisons, not a new independent holdout.
